question: What exalted status is attained as son of Pārvatī?
premises: That person becomes the son of Pārvatī
He is honored by all scriptures
The status combines divine kinship and scriptural esteem
inference: The person attains the honored status of Pārvatī's son recognized by all scriptures.
plain_english: He may become the son of Pārvatī, honored by all the scriptures.
